purpose: Return persisted global project-analysis reports with a separate current canonical LIVE overlay. The report catalog always lists all seven fields; cycle_semantics remains an optional historical report.
parameters: fields (array of strings or null, default null): optional selection of global report sections. Allowed values are summary, structure, name_collisions, artifacts_compact, graph_analytics, report_diff, and cycle_semantics. Null selects exactly the original six reports; an empty array returns no report bodies while retaining the complete catalog and LIVE overlay.
allow_large_output (boolean, default false): approve returning the complete selected response when it exceeds the 51200-byte (50 KiB) direct-response threshold.

cycle_semantics_view (string, default "full"): historical cycle_semantics presentation; one of overview, diagnostic, or full. It applies only when cycle_semantics is selected. Full preserves the persisted report exactly.

cycle_semantics_component (string or null, default null): optional canonical module identity selecting exactly one visible SCC in overview or diagnostic view. It is invalid with full view or when cycle_semantics is not selected.
behavior: 1. Reads persisted reports without rerunning report producers or scanning source files. report_catalog always lists summary, structure, name_collisions, artifacts_compact, graph_analytics, report_diff, and cycle_semantics.

2. fields=null preserves the original six-report selection. fields=[] returns selected_fields=[] and reports={} plus all catalog metadata and the current LIVE overlay. Explicit selections are deduplicated while preserving caller order.

3. The six original required reports alone determine report_bundle_state. Missing or invalid optional cycle_semantics never makes the default six-report bundle incomplete; selecting an unavailable optional report makes the selected response partial.

4. Catalog serialized_bytes and serialized_kib describe the complete persisted report, even when a reduced view is returned. They use exact serialized JSON accounting. They do not describe filesystem size or LIVE freshness.

5. full returns the persisted cycle_semantics report without redaction or reformatting. diagnostic retains the report and bounded projection but omits semantic_evidence.source_fingerprints from transmission and records the omitted count in presentation metadata. overview returns provenance, coverage, issue counts, projection totals/truncation, and concise SCC classifications without lexical-site details, detailed edges, or conditional witness chains.

6. cycle_semantics_component selects one SCC only from the bounded materialized projection. A missing component returns component_not_in_projection with the projection truncation and counts; absence is not inferred from the graph.
7. The 50 KiB guard measures the actual selected response after semantic view projection. Optional views do not change the persisted-report serialized_bytes catalog value.

8. reports contains the persisted historical analysis snapshot; live_state contains current canonical revision, freshness and diagnostics. Historical publication_binding remains UNVERIFIED_REPORT_VS_CANONICAL_LIVE with null revisions. No runtime import safety is certified.

9. live_state.cycle_semantic_diagnostics is derived only from the current canonical CycleSemanticsSnapshot when state_freshness.families.cycle_semantics is positively fresh and the canonical generation is coherent. Its attention value is separate from diagnostics_attention_required; runtime_execution_status remains UNKNOWN_NOT_EVALUATED.
freshness: Persisted reports describe the latest completed full-analysis report write and may be older than the current incremental LIVE revision.
live_state.state_freshness reports the current canonical revision, provenance, family states, workspace-sync status, and advisory warning independently from the report snapshot.
A newer LIVE revision does not relabel persisted report-only analytics as fresh LIVE facts.

If one or more modules are parse-stale, live_state.state_freshness.canonical_state is stale and live_state.parse_stale_modules identifies the affected last-known-good module truths; persisted completed-analysis reports remain independently retrievable.

The explicitly selected cycle_semantics report remains historical even when current LIVE revision is newer or structural diagnostics are fresh. Missing optional files do not affect default six-section completeness.

live_state.state_freshness.families.cycle_semantics independently describes current canonical semantic evidence as fresh, stale, deferred, or unavailable; structural cycles remain a separate family. Fresh requires positive canonical generation coherence and a SHA-256 match with the current in-memory hard dependency graph.
The cycle_semantics family does not reread analyzed Python source or rerun semantic AST analysis. Historical FULL report freshness never proves current LIVE freshness.

diagnostics_summary.cycles.count is the number of unique normalized DFS back-edge paths after rotational deduplication. It is not the number of SCCs, cyclic modules, cyclic edges, runtime failures, or every possible simple cycle. Those measurements can differ; for example, 16 DFS paths can belong to 2 cyclic SCCs containing 33 modules.

diagnostics_attention_required retains its existing structural meaning and may be true when structural cycles exist. direct_candidate_attention_required is a separate semantic signal and does not establish Python initialization failure or runtime safety.
errors: unsupported_fields: one or more requested fields are not global project report sections.
invalid_fields: fields is not an array of strings or null.
invalid_cycle_semantics_view: cycle_semantics_view is not overview, diagnostic, or full.
invalid_cycle_semantics_component: component is not a non-empty module identity or null.
invalid_selection: a non-default semantic view is supplied without selecting cycle_semantics, or a component is combined with full view.
component_not_in_projection: component is not among the SCCs visible in the bounded persisted projection.
usage_notes: Call with fields=[] to inspect the seven-entry catalog and LIVE overlay without returning report bodies. This reduces response tokens; catalog construction still reads persisted report metadata to preserve exact serialized size accounting.
Use fields to fetch one or more exact report sections without semantic truncation. Use allow_large_output=true only after deciding that the complete selected payload is worth the context cost.
For targeted extraction from a very large indexed report, prefer the existing specialized indexed/report-context tools rather than loading hundreds of KiB unnecessarily.

Use fields=["cycle_semantics"] with cycle_semantics_view="overview" for concise evidence, "diagnostic" to omit transmitted source fingerprints, or "full" for the exact persisted report. The full view remains the backward-compatible default.

Use cycle_semantics_component with overview or diagnostic to select a canonical module in a visible SCC. If it is outside the bounded projection, inspect the explicit component_not_in_projection response; do not infer graph absence.
A reduced view remains historical. The LIVE semantic diagnostic is available separately under live_state.cycle_semantic_diagnostics and is freshness-gated.
